collection_method: Elsevier Scopus Search API (ISSN 0144-8617, coverDate desc paging up to ~700 entries, metadata-only screening; abstract retrieval API lacked full abstract entitlement) + PubMed E-utilities (ESearch/ESummary, journal Carbohydr Polym[ta], reldate=730, used to build a DOI->PMID map of 2,893 records over 2 years) cross-referenced against state/seen_articles.json to catch duplicates recorded under pmid rather than pii keys, and to authoritatively determine PubMed publication type (Review vs Journal Article) since Scopus subtype tags were unreliable for several review-style titles. Crossref REST API used to retrieve full author lists (Elsevier metadata-only key returned only first author).
note: Only 7 of 20 target reached. ~700 Scopus entries screened; 94 were duplicates already recorded under pmid identifiers from prior runs; 10 were Scopus subtype='ar' but PubMed pubtype='Review' (excluded); 9 were microbe-strain/bioprocess-centric (excluded); 7 were genuinely new Articles-in-Press (coverDate 2026-10-15) not yet indexed in PubMed.
